# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

<!-- cap-evolve:insights-append-below -->

## Scoring mechanics (airline tau2 val split)
- What worked (confirmed by reading reward_info on all 20 traces): per-trial
  `reward = DB × COMMUNICATE`. COMMUNICATE = 1 on every trial except 11-t0. `action_checks`
  do NOT feed the reward. Implication: routing an action through a differently-named
  composite tool is scoring-neutral if the final DB is identical.
- Promising but not yet tried (pending cand_0002 RESULT): composite `update_reservation`
  as the ONLY modify path (primitives in REMOVE_TOOLS). Verified byte-identical DB vs the
  primitives for baggages/passengers/flights single-field changes, so passing task 12 is
  protected at the tool level; residual risk is weak-model mis-fill of the one richer tool.

## send_certificate compensation guard
- What worked: bounded in-body constraint (amount must be a positive multiple of 50)
  blocks the out-of-policy $116 voucher in 37-t1 while never firing on a valid amount.
  Correct/safe per cand_0001 (broke nothing); re-shipped in cand_0002. Confirm with the
  cand_0002 RESULT whether it (net of the composite) moves task 37.
